title: isomorphic-git allows unbounded memory allocation from attacker-controlled delta target size (DoS) (CVE-2026-63476)
description: isomorphic-git contains a vulnerability where it allocates memory based on an attacker-controlled size value without an upper bound. This can cause a denial of service (DoS) by exhausting memory when processing malicious delta objects during git clone or fetch operations. The issue is fixed in version 1.38.6.
